title: Skyrim VR Native Interaction and Modding Ecosystem

licence_posture.skyrim_vr_game: Bethesda proprietary game; metadata and lawful operator observations only
licence_posture.skse64: Public source with no root licence established by this registration; inspect file-level terms before reuse
licence_posture.vrik: Nexus-hosted creator-controlled distribution; metadata and documented APIs only unless permission permits more
licence_posture.planck: Nexus-hosted creator-controlled distribution; metadata and behaviour evidence only unless permission permits more

evidence_scope: body calibration, gestures and physical holsters
realistic object grabbing, throwing and gravity-glove interaction
physics-step synchronization to headset frame rate
physical character animation and melee kinetics
mod APIs and cross-mod capability composition

allowed: pinned GPL HIGGS source with licence compliance
public SKSE source inspection subject to file-level terms
public Nexus metadata, changelogs and documented interfaces
operator-owned mod-list, configuration, performance and headset evidence
independently authored parity rubrics and method extraction
forbidden: copying Bethesda game assets or binaries
assuming source availability equals permission to reuse
using a mod-list result without preserving its exact component versions
flattening native-game, framework and individual-mod behaviour into one claim

promotion_rule: Use Skyrim VR as the native interaction parity benchmark. Attribute each capability to the base game, SKSE layer or exact mod and version that actually provides it.
